arStrings.szText:
{c_important}Occult Hellfire{/c} Skills are always empowered and consume {c_number}[{SF_0}*100|%|]{/c} of your Maximum Life. 

{c_important}{u}Volatility{/u}{/c} can now stack up to {c_number}{SF_3}{/c} times, increasing the damage of empowered Skills by {c_number}[{SF_4}*100|x%|]{/c} and the Life they consume by {c_number}[{SF_6}*100|+%|]{/c} per stack.

{c_important}Command Valloch{/c} also siphons its life to {c_important}{u}Fortify{/u}{/c} you for {c_number}[{SF_5}*100|%|]{/c} of your Maximum Life and causes {c_important}Valloch{/c} to pay {c_number}[{SF_7}*100|%|]{/c} of Life Costs instead while you've siphoned its power.
